title: Bangkok map: Wat Arun and the Grand Palace
kaylee: The Bangkok map now shows Wat Arun on the Thonburi bank and the Grand Palace across the river, so it looks like Bangkok at a glance. They're scenery only, so tapping them does nothing.
questions: Do they look good enough, or should they be bigger?
Should Wat Pho's chedis join them, or is two enough?
